clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery EXW; standard lead time 35 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

news.headline: CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH fully booked into next year

documents.subject: Capacity situation and delivery dates
documents.author: CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH
documents.text:
Hello,
due to very high capacity utilisation we cannot confirm your full forecast for Flange DN 65 PN 16, machined (part:320030) for the coming months. Lead times are currently longer than agreed. We will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments.
Best regards,
CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH

documents.subject: Payment of invoices
documents.author: CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH
documents.text: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

documents.subject: Supplier day
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: At our supplier day CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

documents.subject: New contact person
documents.author: CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH
documents.text: From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

persona.summary: Founder-led 35-staff CNC shop (2-5 M EUR); our ~EUR 153k is ~3-8 % of its turnover and it calls us a reference customer. Fully booked into next year, cannot confirm our forecast and prioritises firm long-term commitments. Sole active source of flange DN 65 (part:320030); sup:70240 is qualified but also fully booked. Price 4 % over its own should-cost. Open moderately, pay with lead time and a binding 12-month volume, use its terrible OTD as the price argument.
persona.notes: Wants firm, long commitments; fears being tied to unplanned volumes. OTD 56-61.5 % for four quarters (target 95 %). We pay 8 days late on average (73 % of invoices >5 days late) but it has not complained in writing; 10-day pay e-mail only.
fears: committing capacity to unplanned forecast volumes

evidence.quote: We will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments.
CNC-Technik Obermaier & Huber GmbH fully booked into next year
said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.
Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.
avg 8.1 days late, 73.2 % of invoices over 5 days late

levers: longer lead time (~0.5 % of price per day)
arguments: own cost share: price 4 % over its plant should-cost
contract §3.1: no increase notice by 2 Oct
avoid: deep opening (capacity-tight bots jump to a final offer)
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Open moderately, a few percent below current price, not deep.
Offer a binding 12-month volume and accept its longer lead time in return for price.
Use the year of 56-61 % OTD as the quality argument, once.
Do not threaten a switch to sup:70240: it is fully booked too.
playbook.expected_concession: Small: renewals asked +3 % and settled at 0 % twice; expect hold near current price, a few percent at most for lead time and volume.
